selection.basis: Choose one exact mainland observed-price gap with an existing current manufacturer MSRP anchor. The public official page was rechecked on 2026-09-23 and still lists CNY 7,900; one fresh public retail-item search tests whether a buyer-visible current checkout exists.
selection.evidence_only_writer: one existing Luna Max agent; read-only source research, no repository writes
selection.root_writer: integrate only an exact mainland checkout source and observation, or record a one-route blocked disposition

targets.current_state: Candidate is an exact LAGET PIONEER frameset with an official CNY 7,900 MSRP and no observed_price. The manufacturer page rechecked 2026-09-23 repeats the MSRP but does not establish buyer checkout, seller stock, or the actual included package.
targets.new_route_scope: One fresh public web search for a current mainland seller or marketplace item for the exact LAGET PIONEER frameset. Open at most one exact item reached from that query. Stop at the first decisive exact listing; do not repeat the prior 50-area sweep.
acceptance_requirements: The listing must identify LAGET PIONEER specifically, not PIONEER ONE, PIONEER SLR, or another LAGET titanium model.
The seller and mainland marketplace/store must be identifiable, and the item must offer the exact frameset/package rather than an assembled bike or accessory bundle.
A numeric CNY amount must be publicly visible with current stock, purchasable state, dated listing, or equivalent current context. Record seller, package, URL and access date.
Do not treat the CNY 7,900 manufacturer MSRP as a buyer checkout price; do not infer an observed price from search snippets or an official product page alone.
Reject login/private-message/quote-only pages, stale indexes, unclear included components, and seller/model ambiguity.
excluded_routes: manufacturer MSRP without buyer checkout evidence
PIONEER ONE, PIONEER SLR, or other LAGET models
assembled-bike price or ambiguous component bundle
foreign-market amount, unconverted currency, owner recollection, or inaccessible quote

done_criteria: Use one fresh public item-search route and inspect at most one exact seller listing.
If accepted, add a dated source and candidate observed_price with the exact frameset package and visible current CNY amount; preserve official_price separately.
If no accepted checkout is found, add one concise retry attempt with a formal one-route campaign_extension pointing to this scope; preserve the prior official-price evidence and all earlier attempts.
Do not publish or create a marketplace account/order; no login, checkout, private message or purchase is in scope.
Run focused validation and the full repository gate once for any data or research-attempt changes; no images are in scope.
Local B62 batch only; no push, pull request, merge, publication, or production action.
delivery: Local B62 batch only; no push, pull request, merge, publication, or production action.
